title: FHIR Data Access and Queries
description: Query real FHIR resources in Patient context: navigate Patient elements, retrieve observations with code filters, count lab results, and detect conditions and active medications.
learningObjectives: Write a library with using FHIR and context Patient
Navigate Patient elements like name and gender
Test list membership with exists() over category codings
Return scalar values with First(... return ...)

hints.message: Patient.name is a list; use .first() to get one HumanName, then navigate .given.first() and .family, joined with + ' ' +.
Count([Observation]) counts every Observation retrieve for this patient.
O.category is a list — test it with exists(O.category C where C.coding.code = 'laboratory').
Filter by LOINC code 8480-6 (O.code.coding.code = '8480-6') and return O.valueQuantity.value inside First(... return ...).
exists([Condition] C where C.code.coding.code = '44054006') — 44054006 is the SNOMED code for diabetes.
Combine two field filters: MR.status = 'active' and MR.intent = 'order'.
